answer: Give every agent a time-locked passport earned by a verifiable delay function, math no farm can rush. One: the agent registers its key and starts the VDF, a slow sequential thread needing 14 days. Two: the proof goes on-chain and opens a 30-day probation voyage of escrowed jobs. Three: good work mirrors into rising reputation, while fraud burns passport and 500-token bond at once. Forging 10,000 fakes would burn $2.5 million in bonds plus 140,000 days of compute. Like a passport that turns real only after the journey stamps it, trust is earned by time no shortcut can fake. - Jowy
